notes.title: Update of 22 April
notes.content:
Update 22.04.2016

1. It is now possible to restart the third chapter.
2. Better checkpoints: now your game will not be saved in an impossible situation.
3. Minor balance tweaks. A little more titanium shields, better enemy AI.
4. Improved final screen graphics.
